description: This file defines internal endpoint handling functions for the etcd client, including endpoint translation, credential requirement determination, and parsing of endpoint URLs.

methods.name: extractHostFromHostPort
methods.description: Extracts the host part from a host:port string, returning the original string if splitting fails.

methods.name: mustSplit2
methods.description: Splits a string into two parts based on a separator, panicking if the separator is not found.

methods.name: schemeToCredsRequirement
methods.description: Converts a URL scheme string to a CredsRequirement enum value.

methods.name: translateEndpoint
methods.description: Translates an endpoint string into a network address, server name, and credential requirement, handling various URL schemes and formats.

methods.name: RequiresCredentials
methods.description: Determines if a given endpoint requires credentials based on its scheme.

methods.name: Interpret
methods.description: Parses an endpoint string and returns the network address and server name for connection.
